## Choose Which Types of Sub & Sub-Sub Categories Display on Member Profiles


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000074407

By default sub and sub-sub categories will display on member's profiles, once these have been selected by the member in the Additional Details form:


## Select Sub & Sub-sub Category Displa y


In order to display only the sub-sub categories navigate to Settings >> Advanced Settings:

- Show Only Sub-Sub Categories On Member Profiles System Variable: show_subs_member_profile

The available options are Subs only , Sub and sub-subs and sub-sub only :


### Sub-subs Only


If the Sub-subs only option has been selected, only Sub-Sub categories will show up in the Specialties tab:


### Subs Only


If the Subs only option has been selected, only Sub categories will show up in the Specialties tab:


### Sub and Sub-subs


If the Sub and sub-subs option have been selected, both Sub Categories and Sub-Sub Categories will show up in the Specialties tab:
